svg.title: PTX m16n8k16 accumulator lane layout
svg.desc: A sixteen by eight output matrix distributed over thirty-two lanes. Lane zero owns row zero and row eight, columns zero and one. This is an instruction contract, not CUDA WMMA fragment ABI.

g.text: 16 rows × 8 columns · 32 lanes · 4 values per lane
g = lane // 4, u = lane % 4 · row = g + 8(i // 2), column = 2u + (i % 2)
Dense FP16 MMA only. Do not apply this layout to wmma::fragment::x.
